lines.japanese:
心地良い日差し。
　生温い湯に浮かんでいるかのように、うつらうつら
と船を漕ぐ。
lines.english: Pleasant sunlight. He nodded drowsily, as though floating in a bath of lukewarm water.

lines.japanese:
水の香りがするのは、今朝方まで降っていた雨の
せいだろうか。
lines.english: Perhaps the scent of water came from the rain that had fallen until this morning.

lines.japanese:
森の木々が大きく呼吸して、爽やかな空気を運ん
でくれる。
lines.english: The trees of the forest breathed deeply and sent fresh air drifting through the room.

lines.japanese: （いい気持ち……）
lines.english: (This feels nice…)

lines.japanese:
食後は眠くなる。当然の生理だ。
　歴史を語る教師の声は、まるで寝際に聞く
昔話のよう。
lines.english: Sleepiness after a meal was simple physiology. The history teacher’s voice was like an old tale heard at bedtime.

lines.japanese: （このまま寝ちゃっても、怒られないよね）
lines.english: (Nobody will be mad if I fall asleep, right?)

lines.japanese:
知識欲よりも睡眠欲が勝る。
　とても満たされた午後だった―――
lines.english: His hunger for sleep conquered his hunger for knowledge. It was an afternoon of perfect contentment—

lines.japanese: コツン！
lines.english: Thunk!

lines.japanese:
側頭部に軽いものが当たる。
　軽いけれど、尖っていた。
lines.english: Something light struck the side of his head. Light, but pointed.

lines.japanese: （いったい何が……紙？　まさか手紙？）
lines.english: (What was that… Paper? Don’t tell me it’s a note.)

lines.japanese:
切り取られたノート。折りたたまれて結ばれて、
先が尖っている。
lines.english: A torn sheet of notebook paper, folded and tied into a pointed shape.

lines.japanese:
振り返ると、斜め後ろの男子生徒がその手紙を
指さして無言の笑みを浮かべた。
lines.english: He looked back. The boy sitting diagonally behind him pointed to the note with a silent grin.

lines.japanese:
（授業中に手紙だなんて……
　こんなの、初めてなんじゃないのか？）
lines.english: (Passing notes during class… Have I ever done anything like this before?)

lines.japanese:
相手が男子生徒であるにもかかわらずドキドキ
してしまう。
lines.english: His heart raced, even though the other student was a boy.

lines.japanese:
こんな行為、まるで“友達同士”みたいではないか。
　相手の笑顔からして嫌なことが書いてあるとは思い
にくい。
lines.english: This was almost like having “friends.” Judging by the boy’s smile, it could hardly contain anything unpleasant.

lines.japanese:
期待と不安、初めての行為に胸を高鳴らせて、
手紙を開いた。
lines.english: Expectation and unease set his heart pounding as he unfolded the note, swept up in the novelty of it all.

lines.japanese:
―――お前のねーちゃんカレシいんの？
　―――つか処女？
　―――恋人立候補、橋渡し願う。
lines.english:
—ur sis got a bf?
—btw she a virgin?
—bf applicant here. intro plz.

lines.japanese:
―――姉萌え。
　―――生娘であるべき。
　―――漏れがいただくべき？
lines.english:
—older sisters ftw.
—she better be untouched.
—me shuld call dibs?

lines.japanese:
数人の殴り書きに、眠気とは違う目眩を覚える。
　改めて振り返ると、男子生徒は頬を染めて満面
の笑みを浮かべていた。
lines.english: The scrawls of several people left him dizzy for reasons unrelated to sleep. When he looked back again, the boy was blushing and grinning from ear to ear.
(—DIAF.)

lines.japanese: 殺意の波動を送った。
lines.english: He sent a wave of murderous intent his way.

lines.japanese: そして、返す視界に話題の主が登場する。
lines.english: When he turned back, the subject of the note came into view.
(Sis…?)

lines.japanese: 同じクラスに席を持つ“姉”。
lines.english: His “sister” had a desk in the same classroom.

lines.japanese:
眠ろうとしていた愚弟と違って、真面目に授業を
受けている。
　その横顔をつい見つめてしまう。
lines.english: Unlike her foolish little brother, who had been about to sleep, she was paying close attention to the lesson. He found himself staring at her profile.

lines.japanese: （そうだ、姉さん―――イマ）
lines.english: (Right. My sister—Ima.)

lines.japanese:
貴宮イマ。それが彼女の名。
　忍の“姉”は、学校でも有名な美少女だった。
lines.english: Ima Atemiya. That was her name. Shinobu’s “sister” was renowned throughout the school for her beauty.

lines.japanese:
しかし浮いた話ひとつない。
今までは、なかった。
lines.english: And there had never been so much as a romantic rumor about her. Until now, at least.

lines.japanese: （カレシとか……処女とか！）
lines.english: (Boyfriends… virginity!)

lines.japanese: 不愉快な話題だ。
lines.english: The entire subject offended him.

lines.japanese: （なんでもない！）
lines.english: (Nothing!)

lines.japanese:
慌てて頭を振って、視線を屋外へ。
　“姉”は鋭いのだ、いろいろと。
lines.english: He hurriedly shook his head and turned his eyes outside. His “sister” was sharp about all sorts of things.

lines.japanese:
おかしなことを考えていたら、すぐさま読み
取られてしまう。
lines.english: If his thoughts strayed somewhere strange, she would read them at once.

lines.japanese:
落ち着いて、素知らぬふりをして、事なきを得る。
　ホッと一息ついて、再度手紙を見てしまう。
lines.english: He calmed down and feigned innocence until the danger passed. Then, breathing a sigh of relief, he looked at the note again.

lines.japanese:
（何がいただくべき？
　だ……誰だか知らないけど、後で覚えておけよ？）
lines.english: (What do you mean, “call dibs”? I don’t know which of you wrote that, but you’ll pay for it later.)

lines.japanese: 覚えておいてもらっても、何もできないわけだが。
lines.english: Not that there was anything he could actually do to them later.

lines.japanese: （それにしても……相変わらずモテるなぁ）
lines.english: (Still… She’s as popular as ever.)

lines.japanese:
“姉”は容姿端麗なので、男性から視線を浴びる
ことが多い。
lines.english: His “sister” was beautiful, and often drew the gaze of the boys around her.

lines.japanese:
その視線にはもちろん思春期特有の情動も込め
られている。それは分かる。
lines.english: Naturally, those looks were charged with adolescent desire. He understood that much.

lines.japanese:
しかし家族にそうした感情を向けられるのは
居心地の悪さを覚えさせられる。
lines.english: But knowing those feelings were directed at a member of his family made him deeply uncomfortable.

lines.japanese: （なんでもないってば）
lines.english: (I said it’s nothing.)

lines.japanese:
カレシがいるのか？　そんなことは知らない。
　処女なのか？　もちろん知る由もない。
　橋渡しなどゴメンだし、実姉に萌えなどしない。
lines.english: Did she have a boyfriend? He did not know. Was she a virgin? He had no possible way to know. He would not play matchmaker, and he did not have a thing for his own sister.

lines.japanese:
生娘であるべきだなどと言われても、それは彼女
自身の自由であるし、誰かに奪われるなどと考えた
くもない。
lines.english: Whether she remained untouched was her own decision, and he did not even want to imagine anyone taking anything from her.

lines.japanese: あくまでも、家族として。
lines.english: Strictly as her family.

lines.japanese: （人の眠りを妨げてまで訊くことか！）
lines.english: (Was this worth waking me up for?!)

lines.japanese: ノートの切れ端を丸めて紙くずに変える。
lines.english: He crumpled the scrap of notebook paper into a ball.

lines.japanese:
何かを察したのか、イマはやれやれと肩をすく
めた。
　それがまた、忍の居心地を悪くさせる。
lines.english: Perhaps she had sensed something, for Ima shrugged wearily. That only made Shinobu more uncomfortable.

lines.japanese: （人の気も知らないで）
lines.english: (You have no idea how I feel.)

lines.japanese:
紙くずを机の中に押し込む。
　捨てるのを忘れないようにしなければ。
もちろん、イマの目の届かない場所へ。
lines.english: He shoved the crumpled note into his desk. He would have to remember to throw it away. Somewhere safely beyond Ima’s eyes, naturally.

lines.japanese: だと言うのにイマは、ちょいちょいと指を差す。
lines.english: Yet Ima kept making little pointing gestures.

lines.japanese: （気にしなくていいよ）
lines.english: (Don’t worry about it.)

lines.japanese:
声に出すまでもない。
　しかし背後から、声をかけてくる愚か者がいる。
lines.english: He did not need to say it aloud. Even so, the idiot behind him tried to call out.

lines.japanese: （喝ーーッ）
lines.english: (Silence!)

lines.japanese: 男子生徒はビビって首をすくめた。
lines.english: The boy flinched and ducked his head.

lines.japanese:
“姉”には、哀れむように笑われた。
　美少女に相応しい生娘的な笑顔だった。
lines.english: His “sister” smiled at him with something like pity. It was the pure, maidenly smile befitting a great beauty.

lines.japanese:
（……そうだよ、姉さんに彼氏なんているはず
　ないじゃないか）
lines.english: (…Right. Of course Sis doesn’t have a boyfriend.)

lines.japanese:
こういった感情はシスコン故に生まれる。
　忍はイマに、“姉”以上の思いを抱いているの
かもしれなかった。
lines.english: Feelings like these were born of a sister complex. Shinobu might harbor feelings for Ima that went beyond what one felt for a “sister.”

lines.japanese:
姉弟であるどころか、一心同体であるかのような
想いを―――
lines.english: A feeling that they were not merely brother and sister, but one in body and soul—

lines.japanese: （もうっ、僕の平穏な時間を返せっ）
lines.english: (Honestly, give me back my peaceful afternoon!)

lines.japanese:
居心地の悪さを振り払うように、ふてくされて
見せる。
lines.english: He sulked theatrically, as though that might drive away his discomfort.

lines.japanese:
“姉”の笑みが深まるのが分かった。
　クラスの男子たちが息を呑む。女子たちは首を
傾げるばかり。
lines.english: He saw his “sister’s” smile deepen. The boys in the class caught their breath; the girls merely cocked their heads.

lines.japanese: イマ本人も、何も分かってはいないようだった。
lines.english: Ima herself did not seem to understand a thing.

lines.japanese: （無邪気な人だよ、ホント）
lines.english: (You really are innocent.)

lines.japanese: 微笑みを感じながら、目を閉じる。
lines.english: He closed his eyes, still feeling her smile.

lines.japanese:
それは、心地良い日差しのよう。
　温かく、穏やかで、とても安らぐのが分かる。
lines.english: It was like pleasant sunlight. Warm, gentle, and deeply restful.

lines.japanese: （いい気持ち……）
lines.english: (This feels nice…)

lines.japanese:
万年頭痛も和らぐ心地良さに、忍はまた甘い眠り
に誘われる。
lines.english: The comfort even eased his chronic headache, drawing Shinobu back toward sweet sleep.

lines.japanese: 『……おやすみなさい、忍……』
lines.english: “…Good night, Shinobu…”

lines.japanese: 頭を撫でられるかのような声が響き渡った。
lines.english: A voice rang out like a hand stroking his head.

lines.japanese: そんな気がした。
lines.english: That was how it felt.
